The sibling-constructor and final-token tests cover those specific regressions. For the new mutual support, validate_mutual_groups accepts only column-zero named inductives with first-line where headers between standalone mutual/end, rejects unsupported members/nesting/empty or unterminated groups, and checks duplicate member names. The three selected mutual tests cover both members, declarations before/after, rule and kind selection, retained full source, lexical decoys, malformed groups and duplicate declarations.
